subject: Joint live demo & content swap: Integrate Studio + Redwood
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@integratestudio.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan@devpartners.io>
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Joint live demo + content swap idea

Hi Karthik —

Hope you’re well. I’m Sofia (Head of Partnerships at Integrate Studio). We’ve been tracking Redwood’s serving work and would love to propose a joint program for Q4: combine a short live demo showcasing Integrate Studio’s dev tooling + Redwood’s inference runtime, plus a content swap (co-authored blog and social push).

High-level:
- 20–25 minute live demo (integrated workflow)
- 15 minute Q&A / panel
- Co-posted blog (800–1,000 words) + LinkedIn amplification
- Optional: joint booth mini-demo at EdgeAI Summit (Oct 18–19) — Integrate has a booth, we can add a Redwood slot if you’re interested

Would Redwood be open to co-producing? If yes, can you share: speaker availability, preferred format (live vs pre-record), and any DoS/legal pre-reqs (we’ll need logos and a short contract). I attached a one-pager with two example formats.

Attachments: integrate-partner-slate.pdf (PDF, 360KB)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick sync this week.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Partnerships, Integrate Studio
sofia.ramos@integratestudio.com
+1 415-555-0143

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@integratestudio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint live demo + content swap idea

Sofia —

Thanks, this looks great. We’re very interested in a joint demo + blog approach. Quick thoughts:

- Format: live demo + short panel works well; we can do a pre-record backup in case of AV issues.
- Speakers: I can demo the integration (30–40% live inference path), Marissa (PMM) can handle the customer/market context, Ben can join for product Q&A.
- EdgeAI Summit: we can commit to a 20-minute demo slot at your booth if you can confirm the timeslot by 9/20.

Can you share speaker logistics (bios, headshots) and any booth restrictions? Also loop in legal for a short co-marketing agreement — I’ll include Marissa and Ben to handle comms.

I attached a short outline of the demo flow we’d propose. If that looks good, I’ll draft a mutual action plan and timeline (slides due Oct 1, dry run week of Oct 11).

Attachments: redwood-demo-outline.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@integratestudio.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan@devpartners.io>, marketing@integratestudio.com
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint live demo + content swap idea

Thanks Karthik — this aligns with what we had in mind. A few specifics from our side:

- Booth: confirmed — Integrate Studio has a double booth on Oct 18; we can host a 20-min demo at 11:30am on day 1 (please confirm) and a 15-min reprise on day 2 (optional).
- Content: we’ll do the co-authored blog and can promote to our newsletter (6k subs) if Redwood provides a short excerpt and 2–3 pull quotes.
- Logistics: please send speaker bios + headshots by 9/20.
- Commercials: Integrate can cover 50% of a sponsored coffee break if Redwood is open to cost share — our events budget prefers doing this as a single invoice with joint branding.

For the legal bit, I’ve attached our standard co-marketing MSA and a draft sponsor slip. We prefer DocuSign for the signature flow.

Attachments: integrate-co-marketing-msa.pdf (PDF, 120KB), sponsor-slip.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)

If helpful I can schedule a 30-minute sync to run through the mutual action plan. Thoughts on Oct 9–10?

Best,
Sofia

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>

- Budget: OK to split coffee sponsorship 50/50 up to $1,200 each — need finance approval for expense booking.
- Legal: we should run Integrate's MSA through legal ASAP. Tag @Legal to expedite.
- Timeline: agree slides due Oct 1, dry run Oct 11. I’ll draft MAP (mutual action plan) and drop into the Drive link for review.

Attachments: speaker-bios.zip (ZIP, 200KB), ms-team-agenda.xlsx (XLSX, 8KB)

—Marissa
